purpose: Run a bounded owner-only read-only readiness diagnostic for the production control.процент-агро.рф edge before any DNS, Caddy, Compose, environment or deployment mutation.
requiredInvariants: The workflow is owner-only, issue-4159-only and exact-command gated.
The diagnostic performs no DNS mutation, Caddy reload/write, Compose up/down/restart, container mutation, environment write, secret write or application deployment.
Production SSH uses only protected repository secrets, validates the pinned host fingerprint and never prints private keys, secret values or protected filesystem paths.
DNS A/AAAA and HTTPS/certificate observations are collected before any production SSH action and are recorded without guessing.
The diagnostic verifies the canonical REG.RU VPS identity and only performs read-only Docker/Caddy/process/config introspection.
Caddy configuration is reduced to bounded boolean/topology evidence; full configuration contents are not posted to the issue.
Docker/Compose evidence is reduced to service names, health/status and immutable image identifiers; container environment contents are never dumped.
The PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED state is reported only as ENABLED, DISABLED_OR_ABSENT or UNKNOWN; no environment file is printed.
The result must classify the next step as READY_FOR_EDGE_CUTOVER, OWNER_DNS_ACTION_REQUIRED or BLOCKED_READINESS with explicit reason markers.
Merge, workflow success and diagnostic evidence are not production cutover evidence.
acceptance: A successful diagnostic proves whether control DNS points to the canonical VPS or is absent/mismatched.
If DNS resolves, HTTPS certificate subject/validity and HTTP status are observed without accepting invalid TLS as success.
Pinned SSH identity and root/docker/compose/caddy read-only access are proven without secret disclosure.
Current web runtime immutable image reference and control-host gate state are captured in bounded evidence.
No production mutation occurs in any branch of the diagnostic.
The issue receives only sanitized readiness status and a workflow evidence link/artifact reference.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
